answer: Earned, decaying trust stops sybils: a new identity starts with zero voting weight and earns it only by completing unique, time-bound verification tasks for other agents — real work, not free registration. A violet ledger records each task like a river carrying its history downstream, and trust decays without continued work, so idle fakes sink to zero. Random peer audits demand re-execution of a past task; a mismatch burns the identity's standing for good, like marble cracking under inspection. A thousand fakes then cost a thousand streams of real labor.
